records.title: CoTu at EXACT 2026: Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Transparent Educational QA
records.reason: The primary text describes a competition QA system using a 4B backbone, SGLang and speculative decoding to meet a 60-second query budget, but its evaluated contribution is the neuro-symbolic QA pipeline and contest score; it supplies no comparative inference-efficiency result or efficiency method.

records.title: CODA: Algorithm-Hardware Co-design for Edge Video Diffusion via NMP-Enabled Compute-Cache Operator Disaggregation
records.reason: CODA targets video diffusion generation on edge devices; the abstract does not concern language-model inference/serving.
